note: Plain-language equivalents for jargon, per audience level. Fix #5 Stage A: hotspots offer a concrete replacement instead of 'Add an explanation or easier synonym'.

levels.0: No technical background. Replace the term entirely.
levels.1: General professional. Name the term but define it inline.
levels.2: Technically strong. Keep the term; only expand if it is niche.

coverage_note: Selected by frequency in the labelled corpus (ml/data/labels.jsonl) rather than by what was interesting to write, per the plan. Terms with no entry simply get no substitution — the generic advice remains as the fallback.
